MKT20260005
Roll up DUO
🛒 wir-machen-druck.de
1
Go to website https://www.wir-machen-druck.de/ and login with massimiliano@ahooga.bike and password Ahooga26!, alternatively you can create your own account.
2
Search in navigation bar “Roll” and select “Premium-Roll-ups 120 x 200”
3
Select the quantity. Suggestion is to purchase 5 per type for stock reason or 1 if we ship directly to the dealer. Shipping directly to the dealer will actually decrease the shipping cost most probably. “Stuck” means pieces in german.
4
Make sure “Eigene Druckdaten” is selected, it will allow you to upload the file at the end.
5
Choose your shipping method and then click IN DEN WARENKORB.
6
Click on “JETZ DRUCK...” to upload the file and confirm.
7
Choose PDF 1 to add the first of the due roll ups, you can find the file at the following link: ROLL UP 1
8
Then re-do the same procedure from step 2 to step 7 and add PDF 2. Find the file at the link: ROLL UP 2
9
Choose the address “liefereadresse” for the shipment. Click on “liefereaddresse andern” to select a different address.
10
Write the new address or choose from the already used addresses. At this date 5/03/2026 there are no addresses saved in the “already used”. After choosing the delivery adddress click “weiter” to confirm.

MKT20260007
Window Sticker
🛒 wir-machen-druck.de
28
Go to website https://www.wir-machen-druck.de/ and login with massimiliano@ahooga.bike and password Ahooga26!, alternatively you can create your own account.
29
Search in navigation bar “Hinterglasaufkleber ” and click.
30
Choose Hinterglasaufkleber 4/0 farbig bedruckt mit freier Größe (rechteckig)
31
Set up the amount of window sticker the width (Breite) and the height (Höhe), be aware that maximum width is 130 cm.
32
Click Berechen to calculate the cost of the sticker. Theoretically at this stage should not show more than 40 euro.
33
Select all the items below and add quality control – window sticker could be wrong set up.
34
Upload this file: Window Sticker
35
Choose the address “liefereadresse” for the shipment. Click on “liefereaddresse andern” to select a different address.
36
Write the new address or choose from the already used addresses. At this date 5/03/2026 there are no addresses saved in the “already used”. After choosing the delivery adddress click “weiter” to confirm.
